test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight people M, N, P, S, T, V, X and Y are sitting in a straight row and all are facing north. M sits third from one of the extreme ends of the line. N sits second to the right of M. As many people sit to the right of N as to the left of P. S sits third to the right of P. X sits to the immediate right of Y. Only one person sits between X and V.

How many people sit to the right of T?
solution:
According to the information given in question-

1. M sits third from one of the extreme ends of the line. N sits second to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72306184e41d622ea9dcc22e359a302749b0a8db4dc6fb5ec844ef1fc1e03e9.png] 

2. As many people sit to the right of N as to the left of P. S sits third to the right of P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfd4e0473c157f6c831e36a8eb84bff85697f589bc689ec45a11ebe750239a19.png] 

3. X sits to the immediate right of Y. Only one person sits between X and V.

Case I is eliminated as these conditions can not be applied in that case. Thus, final arrangement is-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/887de5a1f26485d8a9563f5ffe7b0d0acd68548d7a679f00b548a81d7f6f1ed8.png] 

Clearly, one person sits to the right of T.

Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
